_comment: Wand calibration of four cameras through two flat tank walls, run 20260727/T0 (2026-10-03-plan.md). Lengths in mm, image coordinates in px. Detections from the user's circle finder; the GUI calibrations calib, calib_2, calib_3 are kept for comparison only.

detections._comment: Wand CSVs in results_dir (the GUI's format: Filtered_Small = end A, Filtered_Large = end B). all: the circle finder's table, 10,936 frames with both balls in all four cameras; gui_8962 and gui_5563: the GUI's filtered sets behind calib_2 and calib_3.

gui_calibrations._comment: The user's earlier GUI calibrations (PINPLATE camFiles cam0.txt ... cam3.txt), in results_dir.

setup._comment: From the user (2026-10-03): 180 mm lenses, 13.5 um pixels (nominal f 13,333 px, not accurate), cameras in air, acrylic walls 0.5 in thick, water inside, the two walls about 90 deg apart; C1 above C2 behind one wall, C3 above C4 behind the other (photo).

rig._comment: plate_wand_io.RigConfig: indices camera side first (air, acrylic, water); cameras in the order of the CSV's camera numbers 0-3 (image folders cam1-cam4, photo C1-C4).

photo_hints._comment: T5 only: each camera roughly square-on to its wall (its window's normal along its optical axis).
